measurement_note: Size is P = tnm, where t is target length and n and m are the two word lengths. Each tier uses all-'a' strings of equal length, so every state and matching-index transition is live. Directional prefix sums make the reference linear in P, while directly enumerating every next matching index from every state adds another length factor.
